description: Defines the ThingsboardErrorResponse class, which represents error responses with HTTP status, message, error code, and timestamp, used for exception handling in the Thingsboard server.

classes.name: ThingsboardErrorResponse
classes.description: A class representing structured error responses with status, message, error code, and timestamp.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ThingsboardErrorResponse.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code as an integer.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the error response was created.
